{{Recipe}}

This recipe for '''spiced oysters''' has been adapted and modernized from the 1881 ''Household Cyclopedia.''

== Ingredients ==

* 100 [[Cookbook:Oyster|oysters]]
* 12 whole [[Cookbook:Clove|cloves]]
* 24 whole [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]]
* [[Cookbook:Mace|Mace]], to taste
* [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|Cayenne pepper]], to taste
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|cider vinegar]]

== Procedure ==

# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] the oyster liquor through a [[Cookbook:Sieve|sieve]], and put it in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
# Add the oysters, spices, salt, and cider vinegar.
# Place them over a slow fire, and as soon as they [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] remove them from the heat.
# Pour the oysters into a large bowl, and let cool.
# When cooled, cover and store the oysters.
